scope: IN: the per-run log file name; its unit tests; the Platform_Settings_UI component document if it describes log naming. OUT: ticket 7, already satisfied; log rotation policy; retention window; log format.
alignment.understanding: Ticket 6 is real: _build_log_file_path formats APP_NAME_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S.log and _open_run_log_file passes mode='w', so a second process starting inside the same wall-clock second opens the identical path and truncates the first run's log, destroying diagnostics exactly when two instances are running. Fix by making the name unique per process: keep the human-readable second-resolution timestamp and append the process id, which distinguishes concurrent starts deterministically and keeps the *.log glob used by retention cleanup working. Ticket 7 is already fixed: candidate.stat() in _cleanup_old_log_files is inside a try/except OSError that continues, and the function documents retention as best-effort, so the reported crash cannot occur; the reported line numbers are stale. No change is made for it.
